title: The gate classifier does not read the word 'token' in a model-usage question as a secret
goal: bl_authority's class of a gate reads 'token' as a secrets word only where it means a credential, so a question about input tokens or the spend of a run stays a design gate; today an unbounded 'token' match makes it blocking (a SP-hm4qgf3t worker dropped a gate for it). ST-yn3fa5ts covers the same misreading of 'rule'.
